fn sum_of_digits_pure(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n < 10) then n else ((n % 10) + sum_of_digits_pure((n / 10)))))
  effects pure
  example (sum_of_digits_pure(0) == 0)
  example (sum_of_digits_pure(1) == 1)
{
  if (n < 10) then n else ((n % 10) + sum_of_digits_pure((n / 10)))
}

fn skjkasdkd(lst: List[Int]) -> Int

  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (forall x in lst: not ((x >= 2) and (forall k in 2..x: ((x % k) != 0))))) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((not (exists x in lst: ((x >= 2) and (forall k in 2..x: ((x % k) != 0))))) or (exists largest in lst: ((((largest >= 2) and (forall k in 2..largest: ((largest % k) != 0))) and (forall y in lst: ((not ((y >= 2) and (forall k in 2..y: ((y % k) != 0)))) or (y <= largest)))) and (result == sum_of_digits_pure(largest)))))
  effects pure
  example (skjkasdkd([]) == 0)
